name: Apparel Manufacturing Co., Inc.
old_description: Located in the metro-Atlanta area since 1981, Apparel Manufacturing's full array of branded merchandise travels to thousands of businesses and organizations, both nationwide and internationally.  All apparel products are embroidered, screen printed, or custom cut-and-sewn in our Lilburn, GA facility.  Over the last forty-four years, Apparel Manufacturing has grown from a humble staff of two to one of the most trusted names in the industry. When it comes to providing solutions for our clients, "no" is not an option!
about:
Apparel Manufacturing Co., Inc. has operated in Lilburn, Georgia, a suburb of Atlanta, since 1981. The family-owned business began as a two-person screen-print shop and has grown to a staff of fifty under the leadership of President and CEO Martin S. Tulis.

The company provides decorated apparel and promotional products from its in-house production facility. Core processes include screen printing, custom embroidery, and custom cut-and-sew, supplemented by a webstore fulfillment service for client orders. The facility handles both decoration of sourced blank goods and full custom sewing projects.

Apparel Manufacturing serves businesses and organizations across the United States and internationally, supplying branded merchandise for corporate identity programs, tradeshow giveaways, and employee uniform programs. Customers range from small companies to large enterprises seeking promotional items such as polo shirts, hoodies, caps, and technology accessories.

The company emphasizes a “no is not an option” service philosophy, positioning itself as a one-stop shop that combines production and logistics under one roof. Its longevity and family ownership are cited as foundations for consistent quality and responsiveness.
